notes: Problem: incomplete failure reports force maintainers to repeatedly request the command, bounded logs, environment, and Git context.
Audience: maintainers plus contributors or users preparing a useful failure report.
Result: a local reviewable report directory and optional ZIP containing a human report, structured manifest, and bounded command streams.
Upload boundary: ReproBrief does not automatically upload or send the package.
Primary risk: an approved recipe executes trusted programs without a sandbox, and generated files still require manual review.
A compact text input/output preview is clearer than an unverified screenshot for v0.1.0, so visual proof is not required.

Clean verification on 2026-07-29: exact v0.1.0 Git install completed in 6.20 seconds; the documented init, inspect, and run --yes --archive path produced the report directory and ZIP in 1 second in a disposable repository.
A separate real-TTY run confirmed the interactive reprobrief run confirmation path and successful report output.
